name: Colorful Kiss ~12 ko no Mune Kyun!~
original_name: カラフルキッス ～12コの胸キュン！～
source:
Main character returns to his alma mater for teaching practice starting in the fall. According to facility rule he has to stay at student dormitory. His stay there is full of nostalgia. Oh, and there are so many events at school - sports festivals, culture festivals and school trips. He gets in touch with many juniors through these multiple occasions. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公从秋季开始回到母校进行教育实习。根据校方规定，他必须住进学生宿舍。那里的生活令他充满怀念。学校还有许多活动——体育祭、文化祭与修学旅行。他通过这些场合与许多后辈产生交流。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
